verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to choose a storage region or data-residency location for a Customer.io workspace. The only related item addresses residency requirements with a user-side workaround: synthetic email addresses forwarded through the customer's own email relay. That is adjacent to the story, not region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: If you have data residency or PII compliance requirements that prevent you from storing real email addresses outside a specific jurisdiction, you can use synthetic email addresses with an email relay.
